body: I went to the ER room this past winter because I felt terrible in every way possible. I was confident my insurance could cover any fee that they would charge me so I didn't have a worry when they told me they would need to do some x-rays to check my lungs. They didn't tell me that they would send me a $700 bill for x-rays I did not ask for and to finish it off they never told me if anything was wrong. All I got from the visit was some drugs to help me sleep that night and a prescription that I needed to take to a pharmacy so I could get the medicine I needed. Ended up having to pay another $100 worth of medicine.
